why_this_file_exists: Phase 4 S7 declares seven authority moves and lands four: Hypershot, Abyssal Unmake, Bloodsong, Shadowflame. Three of the four landed. Shadowflame did not, and the reason is not effort or judgement but a declaration shape the campaign has not ruled: its walk half delivers its number as a rider on an existing damage event rather than as a packet, and no MechanicCapability shape can say that. Written down as a dated, gated artifact rather than as commit-body prose, because prose is what the next baseline re-capture absorbs. The second entry is a plan/tree divergence a landed slice took deliberately and may not resolve from an implementation lane.

defects.raised_by: the S7 implementation lane, before its first Shadowflame src/ edit
defects.what: shadowflame.cinderbloom's authority move cannot be declared. The mechanic's coupled half is an AmpBonus rider on its triggering Damage event (phase-4 ruling: 'a LivePredicate, never a window; the bonus becomes a rider on its triggering event, read before absorption'), so it authors no packet. The registry has no shape for that: a PAIRED walk half must carry a packet_source (trigger_stream._validate_pairing, 'the walk half's packet is what the pair half is paired against'), and a WALK row carrying a packet_source with a cross-participant authority joins scripts/golden_snapshot.cross_participant_producers() — the set D-07 rules is exactly the six damage_modifier producers and umbrella criterion 3 pins at six. Cinderbloom's declared Subject is HOLDER: it amplifies the holder's own magic and true damage on a predicate about the target's live health, so it modifies no other participant's damage and declaring it a seventh cross-participant producer would make a ruled count wrong.
defects.why_this_lane_may_not_fix_it: Both candidate fixes are somebody else's. (a) Generalising Pairing/packet_source so a PAIRED half may declare a rider source is a Phase 2 structural rule, and the runbook's ownership map gives this lane only view_tags, holder_stacking and the HolderStacking enum in trigger_stream.py. (b) Adding a rider-delivery field to MechanicCapability is forbidden outright: phase 4 writes exactly two fields there 'and no third'. Choosing between them is a design ruling, and an implementation lane inventing one is how a declaration stops meaning what the umbrella says it means.
what_is_already_true_and_needs_no_ruling: The pair half already declares authority=COUPLED_AUTHORITATIVE_WITH_PAIR_PREVIEW, which is the correct ruling and was landed in Phase 2.

The preview-exclusion mechanism the move needs already exists and is live: damage.py stamps a row with pair_preview_of, trigger_stream declares the pair lane THEORETICAL, and participant_timeline._pair_packet keeps previewed rows and their events out of everything the roster composes. Shadowflame's move needs exactly two lines of it — a view_tag=ViewTag.THEORETICAL on the pair row and a pair_preview_of stamp on damage._add_shadowflame_cinderbloom's breakdown row — plus the walk half that has no shape.

The kernel-side work is scoped and unblocked: a LiveAmp value field on SurvivalAction, evaluated by tag inside survival/transitions._apply_live_packet_chain, which is already the pre-absorption point the ruling requires.
defects.population_measured_before_the_lane_stop: The coupled-golden population for this move is genuinely 0, and now for a stated reason rather than an assumed one: six committed coupled scenarios equip Shadowflame (the Syndra pins) and in all six the coupled composition holds no enemy participant at all — combat.participants is main plus ally:Syndra and both breakdown rows total 0.0 — so no subject exists whose live health could satisfy the predicate. The other seven scenarios equip no Shadowflame. The pair snapshot is untouched by a walk-side rider. The bench population is NOT zero and was not enumerated: the three enemy-bearing bench scenarios may propose Shadowflame as a candidate, and a walk-side Cinderbloom could move a candidate's score there. Whoever lands this move owes that enumeration before its first src/ edit (R-20's second half).
defects.reproducer: Add a WALK MechanicCapability for shadowflame.cinderbloom with pairing=PAIRED and packet_source=None: trigger_stream raises TriggerRegistryError at import ('is PAIRED and declares no packet_source'). Give it any packet_source instead and tests/test_trigger_stream.py's producer-identity assertion goes red, because cross_participant_producers() gains a seventh member.

defects.raised_by: the S7 implementation lane, in the commit that landed the move
defects.what: The umbrella's semantic-authority table rules bloodsong.expose_weakness COUPLED_AUTHORITATIVE. The slice landed COUPLED_AUTHORITATIVE_WITH_PAIR_PREVIEW.
defects.why: Plain COUPLED_AUTHORITATIVE is unconstructible for this mechanic. item_support_effects._check_cross_participant_authority resolves a damage_modifier packet's authority through trigger_stream.CROSS_PARTICIPANT_AUTHORITIES, whose three members are the ones that say a second engine can see the mechanic. Bloodsong's pair pricer (damage._add_expose_weakness) still exists — golden pins it and deleting it is a pair-engine change this slice does not make — so a second engine does see it, and declaring otherwise makes the packet fail to build at runtime.
defects.why_the_ruling_is_still_honoured: The row's binding obligation is 'pair and walk are not numerically equivalent; never unify inside a slice labelled a pure refactor'. Nothing was unified: one side is named the answer, the other is tagged THEORETICAL and excluded from every roster total, and the slice is labelled semantic.
defects.for_the_umbrella_owner: Either the table's member is refreshed to the constructible one, or the pair pricer is scheduled for deletion in a slice that owns damage.py and can move the pair golden. An implementation lane may not choose.
defects.reproducer: Set the walk half's authority to Authority.COUPLED_AUTHORITATIVE and run pytest tests/test_item_support_effects.py: every Bloodsong packet raises ValueError('Bloodsong — Expose Weakness modifies another participant's damage but names no Authority').
